nodes.label: One flag worth calling out explicitly: \_check\_not\_in\_cooldown() in the receiver reads risk\_manager.\_last\_closed as a plain dict with no lock. If the Timer fires at exactly 120.000s and the position monitor hasn't finished writing \_last\_closed yet, the re-entry could slip through with a stale won=None.
